title: A literal pattern and a euclid rhythm
teaches: A :pattern track is queried on the bar grid: one pattern cycle is one bar. (pure x) makes one hap for the whole cycle, while (euclid k n x) places k onsets across n slots and leaves gaps where no hap is active.
observe: pulse writes 0.8 at slots 0, 3 and 6 of eight.
A gap omits the write entirely rather than writing zero.
The 2 s frame is cycle 1 slot 0, so the tresillo repeats.
